scope: Roof winding only: Amsterdam Pipe Museum text-free draft and deployed Willet-Holthuysen asset; no recognition or live-game acceptance.

method.glbDecode: glTF-Transform NodeIO with ALL_EXTENSIONS and meshopt.decoder; normalized accessor getElement values transformed by node.getWorldMatrix
method.triangleClassification: Cross product of POSITION edges in metre-scale Y-up coordinates; nonzero normal Y distinguishes top surfaces from vertical skirts. Roof helper constructs hip tops before separate skirts.
method.quantizationLimit: Compressed GLBs can collapse or perturb small triangles. Their small upward slivers do not refute the downward orientation of broad hip planes; both raw geometric counts and area-aware totals retained.

change.behavior: Per-triangle cross-product guard reverses second and third vertices only when a triangulated hip top points downward, before skirt triangles are appended. RecomputeVertexNormals uses corrected winding.
change.unchanged: Native vertex locations, face counts, clipping planes, rises, source outlines, court openings, vertical skirts, all non-roof builder calls, Pipe text removal and all Willet facade/ornament geometry.
